p0_l2.desc: P0.2 persisting-L2 exit check on one GPU

e1.desc: E1 two-tier sweep: hot set W (persisting off/0.5/0.75/1.0/1.0L) + 512 MiB cold set per token, one CUDA graph

e2_08b.desc: E2 Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 decode vs context, bytes split by diffing contexts

e2_2b.desc: E2 Qwen3.5-2B BF16 decode vs context, bytes split by diffing contexts

e3d.desc: E3d fully resident ternary draft step (D 16-160 MiB) off/on persisting, steady and after a 6 GiB verify pass, PDL 0/1

e4_pq2.desc: E4 Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 llama-bench sweep and ncu kernel split

e4_ptq1.desc: E4 Bonsai 2 27B PTQ1_0 llama-bench sweep and ncu kernel split

e4_pdl.desc: E4 PDL A/B: llama-bench tg128 at depth 0/32K with GGML_CUDA_PDL=0, =1, =1 plus GGML_CUDA_PDL_PREFETCH=1/4 and a PDL=0 plus prefetch=4 control, Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0/PTQ1_0 and the E5 draft alone; test-backend-ops MUL_MAT(_ID) and fused mat-vec prefetch off/on; needs --allow-long (failsafe 70: clone, cold CUDA build, ~16 GB of downloads, 40 llama-bench runs)

e5_base.desc: E5 baseline: Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 without speculation, 200 prompts

e5_k4.desc: E5 speculative decoding K=4 with Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 draft

e5_k6.desc: E5 speculative decoding K=6 with Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 draft

e5_k8.desc: E5 speculative decoding K=8 with Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 draft

e5_cost.desc: E5 step cost: Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 verify batch cost for widths 1-9 (llama-bench -p W -n 0 -d 512), the Qwen3.5-0.8B draft decode cost and draft batch cost for widths 1-9 (BF16, Q8_0; the draft re-eval of each verify batch); break-even acceptance per K with and without the re-eval term

r1.desc: R1 pre-E6 measurements on one PRO 6000: (b) E5 matrix on N fixed-seed prompts sized from a cost model, plus extra code_fix/refactor prompts (20 per category) for base and the n-gram configs: target alone, draft-simple K=4 (control), K=4 with target backend sampling (-bs), K=4 with the post-hoc PTQ1_0 draft, ngram-mod / ngram-map-k on the code categories (per-category r, alpha, tok/s, speedup with bootstrap CI, output equality, rollback path from the n_rs_seq log line; K=2/3 are opt-in via --configs); (a) Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16/Q8_0/post-hoc PTQ1_0 top-1 agreement and KL vs Bonsai 2 27B PQ2_0 (llama-perplexity, 8192 tokens, E5 chat text built from part b outputs); (c) one nsys capture of ~20 K=4 steps split by stream role into verify, draft re-eval, draft steps, copies and idle; needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~14 (850 s measured) + downloads <= 6 (fetch_models --timeout-min 6) + r1 29 + end reserve 5; est 35 = downloads 6 + r1 29)

r2a.desc: R2a long-context agentic prompts on one PRO 6000 (exps/data/prompts_r2a.jsonl: 40 code edits embedding one repo file of 2-8K tokens, the modified file from the edit on or a unified diff, and 20 multi-turn tool-call traces in the native tool format; n_predict 320 / 512 / 128, ctx 16384, every server with -lv 4): (m) target alone, draft-simple K=4 (Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16; K=2/3 opt-in via --configs), ngram-mod (default and short parameters) and ngram-map-k (short; default parameters and K=2/3 on a follow-up pod), seeded prompt and config order, base again at the end as a drift bound, per category and overall tok/s, speedup, r, alpha with bootstrap 95% CIs, greedy equality against target alone, spec path and rollback (n_rs_seq, seq_rm lines) from the logs, prompt count sized from a cost model (17 per category planned, cut evenly; whole configs are dropped before prompts fall below 15 per category); (c) same-pod overhead control: unprofiled K=4 on a fixed 10-prompt subset followed by the nsys capture of the same requests (allowlisted env, private dir, decode steps only); (p) -lv 5 probe (LLAMA_TRACE=1, private log dir) counting speculative checkpoint create/restore events and replay steps; needs --allow-long (failsafe 55 = clone, apt, torch and cold CUDA build ~14 + downloads <= 6 (fetch_models --timeout-min 6) + r2a 29 + end reserve 5; est 35 = downloads 6 + r2a 29)
